source.title: Layered ridges at dusk
source.description: Layered ridges at dusk as a flat-vector landscape, suited to desktop and phone wallpapers.
source.body:
## What is it good for?

A calm, low-detail image that sits behind icons and text without competing with them.

## How do I adjust it?

- Change the number of ridges to control depth: three feels open, five feels layered.
- Name the time of day instead of listing colours; the sky gradient follows it.

target.title: 黃昏的層疊山脊
target.description: 扁平向量風格的風景插畫“黃昏的層疊山脊”，適合用作桌面與手機桌布。
target.body:
## 適合用在哪裡？

畫面平靜、細節少，放在圖示和文字後面也不會喧賓奪主。

## 怎樣調整？

- 改變山脊的數量來控制縱深：三層顯得開闊，五層顯得層次豐富。
- 寫出一天中的時刻，而不是逐個列出顏色，天空的漸層會隨之變化。

source.title: Geometric concert poster
source.description: Geometric concert poster as a Bauhaus-style poster, suited to event posters.
source.body:
## What is it good for?

Bold geometry that stays legible from across a room, with bars reserved for event details.

## How do I adjust it?

- Give every shape a position (upper right, lower left); the layout stays balanced.
- Keep the palette to four colours plus the background.

target.title: 幾何風音樂會海報
target.description: 包浩斯風格的海報“幾何風音樂會海報”，適合用作活動海報。
target.body:
## 適合用在哪裡？

醒目的幾何圖形，隔著一個房間也看得清，並預留了放活動資訊的色條。

## 怎樣調整？

- 為每個圖形指定位置（右上、左下），版面會保持平衡。
- 配色控制在背景色之外的四種顏色以內。

source.title: Tea can on a sage backdrop
source.description: Tea can on a sage backdrop as a flat-vector product illustration, suited to packaging and labels.
source.body:
## What is it good for?

Keeps the product shape readable and leaves a clean area for a label or logo.

- A soft circular backdrop separates a pale product from a pale wall.
- To change the subject or colours, start from the [product poster template](template:t_001).

target.title: 鼠尾草綠背景上的茶罐

target.body:
## 適合用在哪裡？

產品輪廓清晰，並為標籤或標誌留出乾淨的區域。

## 怎樣調整？

- 先描述物體的輪廓，再描述標籤，標籤的比例會更準確。
- 柔和的圓形背景能把淺色產品和淺色牆面區分開。
- 想換主體或配色，可以從[商品海報範本](template:t_001)開始。

source.title: Sailboat at sunset
source.description: Sailboat at sunset as a flat-vector landscape, suited to framed art prints.
source.body:
## What is it good for?

Flat shapes and a limited palette print cleanly at large sizes and look deliberate on a wall.

## How do I adjust it?

- Move the horizon with words like “low horizon” or “high horizon” to change the mood.
- Ask for horizontal reflection lines to keep the water flat and graphic.

target.title: 日落時的帆船
target.description: 扁平向量風格的風景插畫“日落時的帆船”，適合用作裝裱的裝飾畫。
target.body:
## 適合用在哪裡？

平塗色塊和有限的配色在大尺寸印刷時依然乾淨，掛在牆上顯得有設計感。

## 怎樣調整？

- 用“低地平線”或“高地平線”這樣的詞移動海平線，可以改變氛圍。
- 要求水平的倒影線條，水面會保持平整、圖形化。

source.title: Neon rim-lit profile
source.description: Neon rim-lit profile as a neon-lit portrait, suited to profile pictures and avatars.
source.body:
## What is it good for?

Works when cropped to a circle: the subject sits in the centre with a simple background.

## How do I adjust it?

- Name two rim colours, one for each side, to keep the outline readable.
- Keep the face in shadow; detail inside the silhouette breaks the effect.
- To change the subject or colours, start from the [neon portrait template](template:t_003).

source.body:

- 想换主体或配色，可以从[水墨长卷模板](template:t_002)开始。

## How to use

Both were recorded on October 29, 2026 using the built-in image tool.

The GPT Image 2.5 display version comes from the [project owner's version attribution](https://github.com/picontapLab/prompt-seen/blob/89395feb8e5fda7419aa3f5d2594df8a71fb3363/production/model-version-annotation-2026-11-05.json).
